# Direct generic seeds beside reifiable contexts

This independently authored static entry takes a Map<?,?>, a direct own formal,
a scalar and a nongeneric configuration. Its relay omits the scalar. The same
formal appears in the result; the reifiable context supplies no method binding.
An opaque callback chooses the actual result independently of the seed.

The observer checks nulls, distinct replacements and aliases, original map and
configuration identities, snapshots, callbacks, map/configuration mutations,
exact failures, original casts and ignored calls. Source and SDK profiles compile
all Java8 units and retain every definition, generic Signature, role and
Exceptions attribute. Twenty-two wrong programs precede recovery. Signature-only
controls retain Code/descriptors while changing scope, arity or reifiability.

The same complete binding also retains an array result of the own formal.
Additional raw/typed array callers preserve the provider's original Object[]
check and the caller's String[] check, nulls, replacements and exact array
identities. Independent wrong programs copy a returned array or erase its
original narrow cast.
